# What's your SALT deduction actually capped at?

> Free calculator for the SALT (state and local tax) itemized deduction cap under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act — applies the 2025/2026 $40,000/$40,400 cap, the 30%-of-excess-MAGI phase-out above $500,000/$505,000, and the $10,000 floor the cap can never drop below, by filing status.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
